## Problem

A clear description of the problem or missing capability. What user need is
unmet?

## Proposed solution

A concise description of what you want to happen.

## Implementation sketch

- Files likely touched: `src/tools/registry.ts`, `src/tools/<slug>/<Name>Tool.tsx`
- Approach: (e.g., new tool page following the registry pattern, new hook, new UI component)
- Any new dependencies required: (or none)

## Impact

Who is affected and how? (e.g., new tool for all users, performance improvement for large inputs, accessibility fix)

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you prefer the proposed one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1 (e.g., tool generates correct output for valid inputs)
- [ ] Criterion 2 (e.g., handles edge cases gracefully)
- [ ] Criterion 3 (e.g., passes lint, tests, and build)
